# vendor/

Place the pyhailort wheel here before running `docker build`:

```
hailort-4.24.0-cp313-cp313-linux_aarch64.whl
```

Download it from the Hailo Developer Zone (free account required):
Software Downloads → HailoRT → "Python package (whl)" → match version
`4.24.0`, Python `3.13`, architecture `aarch64`.

This file is not committed to git (see `.gitignore`) since it requires a
Hailo Developer Zone account to obtain.
